title: Auto Loans Rate Sheet: Base Rates, Grade Adders, Reductions and Floors
content:
Rates published for the Auto Loans line are quoted as an annual percentage rate. The base rate is read from the product and the chosen term; the credit grade adder is read from the grade underwriting assigns; the reductions and the floor are product figures.

## Base annual percentage rate by product and term

| Product | 36 months | 48 months | 60 months | 72 months | 84 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 7.49 | 7.74 | 7.99 | 8.49 | term not offered |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 6.74 | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.74 | term not offered |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.49 | 7.99 | term not offered |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 6.89 | 7.14 | 7.39 | term not offered | term not offered |
| New Vehicle Loan | 5.99 | 6.24 | 6.49 | 6.99 | 7.49 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 5.49 | 5.74 | 5.99 | 6.49 | 6.99 |

The terms offered are the columns carrying a rate: 36, 48, 60 and 72 months on the Used Vehicle Loan, the Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan and the Auto Refinance Loan; 36, 48 and 60 months on the Lease Buyout Loan; and 36, 48, 60, 72 and 84 months on the New Vehicle Loan and the Green Vehicle Loan.

## Percentage points added for credit grade

| Product | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 0.0 | 1.5 | 3.5 | 6.0 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 0.0 | 1.25 | 3.0 | 5.5 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 0.0 | 1.25 | 3.0 | 5.5 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 0.0 | 1.25 | 3.0 | 5.5 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 0.0 | 1.25 | 3.0 | 5.5 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 0.0 | 1.25 | 3.0 | 5.5 |

## Reductions, the ceiling on them and the floor beneath the rate

| Product | Automatic-payment reduction, percentage points | Relationship reduction, percentage points | Most percentage points all reductions together may take off | Rate below which reductions never take the rate | Automatic-payment reduction withdrawn when the standing draft instruction is withdrawn |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 4.49 | yes |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 4.49 | yes |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 4.49 | yes |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 4.49 | yes |
| New Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 3.99 | yes |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 3.49 | yes |

The checking tiers that earn the relationship reduction are Premier Checking and Private Client Checking, on every product of the Auto Loans line.

## Reading the sheet

A Green Vehicle Loan written over 84 months to a grade C borrower reads 6.99 from the base table and 3.0 from the adder table, which is 9.99 before any reduction. The same loan to a grade A borrower reads 6.99 and 0.0, which is 6.99. Neither figure sits near the 3.49 floor published for that product, so the floor does not bind either quotation.
